business: KPIT is a global AI-led mobility technology company serving automotive OEMs. Provides software-defined vehicle solutions, electrification, autonomous, and AI engineering across 15+ countries. 12,000+ engineers power 20M+ production vehicles.
revenue_mix: Geographic presence: Americas, Europe, India, China, Japan, SE Asia. Product mix shifting: 21% of pipeline now solutions/products (vs. traditional engineering); 70% of new contracts fixed-price.
strategy: Build future-ready technology MOAT: AI engineering, solutions, products, M&A
Expand growth frontiers: geographies, verticals, adjacencies (robotics, aerospace, micromobility)
Amplify ecosystem leadership: partnerships, alliances, co-innovation
Deepen client relationships: outcome-based engagements on complex programs
outlook: FY27 turbulent: two major SDV programs winding down H1 offset by new account growth, Trucks/Off-Highway, India, China momentum. Medium-term: solutions/products drive increasing revenue share; per-person value improves; profitability strengthens.
capex_plans: Technology investments exceed 5% of revenue. Strategic M&A for focused acquisitions planned. Specific capex amounts not disclosed in opening pages.
risks: Supply chain disruptions, softer regional demand impacting FY26 H2 and FY27
Competitive pressure from China; geopolitical uncertainty
Major SDV programs winding down create near-term revenue headwind
Near-term profitability pressure from strategic AI/solutions/products investments
flags: Co-founder Ravi Pandit passed May 8, 2026 - significant transition to professional management led by Kishor Patil (CEO/MD). Board refreshed: directors departed/appointed Jan-Jul 2026. No auditor qualifications or contingent liabilities disclosed in opening pages.
